summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing a commercial agreement with a pharmacy benefit manager effective immediately, providing coverage for TONMYA to roughly 21 million Medicare Part D beneficiaries. Combined government and commercial coverage now reaches approximately 166 million individuals. No financial terms, pricing, or counterparty were disclosed. The filing, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, is a routine product-coverage announcement, not a special situation; no advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are implicated. Watch reimbursement expansion and any resulting prescription trends.
